## Activity

During July 2019, the clinic team at Hill Counties Health Centre completed 63 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of the routine site operations process. The completed captures provide the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading activity. Staff reported no new equipment faults this month, and operations continued without any recorded equipment-related interruption.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 5 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.9. This result is noted for routine monitoring and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity at the site. The finding provides an indication of image quality during the reporting period and supports ongoing review of capture practice.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1. This indicates that grading activity was completed within a short interval for the reporting period. The results should continue to be managed through the usual referral and follow-up arrangements.
